audit.why: Difficulty 8/10 HARD matches a 53.41% owner win rate across 1350 games: Irelia owns levels 1-5 via Bladesurge refreshes, Kassadin owns level 6 onward.
audit.corrected: Early lane is hers; side lane and teamfights flip to Kassadin once Riftwalk is stacking.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described Vanguard's Edge as a 'stun' and credited Kassadin's Q with a 'silence'.
audit.why: Riot's text for Vanguard's Edge is damage + Mark + a slowing wall; no stun. Kassadin's Q text is damage + interrupt channels + a shield that absorbs MAGIC damage. Irelia's damage is physical/true, so the Q shield does not blunt her.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around Riftwalk (5/3.5/2s) and Rod of Ages, not a nonexistent silence or an irrelevant magic shield.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claimed Q silence cancels her E engage and that the passive shield absorbs her burst.
audit.why: Q interrupts CHANNELS — that is Defiant Dance (W), her charged strike — not Flawless Duet (E), which is an instant converging stun. And the Q shield absorbs magic damage, which Irelia does not deal. Bladesurge (Q) refreshes on a kill or a Marked target, so any low minion is a free re-engage.
audit.corrected: Q-interrupt Defiant Dance; dodge the Flawless Duet converge; fight away from low minions to deny the Bladesurge refresh; blink out of the Marked follow-up with Riftwalk.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns contained no digit at all (lint: COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Flawless Duet 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Bladesurge 10/9/8/7/6s but refreshes on kills, Riftwalk 5/3.5/2s.

audit.why: missingInteractions flags needs-antiheal: Bladesurge heals her on every reset, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades. The pronoun was also wrong.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal named against her Bladesurge healing.

I proposed the three side flips as one atomic group; no paired content edit exists because win[4..6] are already correct on disk. Ratings left untouched. TWO REAL FACT ERRORS SHIPPED ON THIS PAGE: (1) 'Q silence' — Kassadin's Q interrupts channels, it does not silence, so it cannot cancel Flawless Duet; it CAN cancel Defiant Dance (W), a charged strike. (2) Kassadin's Q shield absorbs MAGIC damage while Irelia deals physical/true — the shield does nothing for this matchup, yet the page sold it as the level-9 flip. Both corrected. Irelia E carries a derived 'grounding' flag in the kit file that Riot's own description does not support (text is damage + stun + Mark only); I did not assert grounding anywhere. Vanguard's Edge was described as a 'hard stun' — Riot's text and the flags say damage + Mark + slowing wall, no stun; corrected to Mark + wall.
